thread:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — PR #16642 is code-review-approved and ready to land, but CI is flaky on integration-e2e and theres a schema migration lock scheduled at 02:00 UTC tonight. @Taylor (release) do we want to: a) hold until after the blackout window, b) try a manual canary landing before the lock, or c) split the migration out?

Jamie Patel: Id prefer to avoid touching the schema right before the lock. If we can avoid the migration in this PR and do a follow-up, that would be safest.

Sanjay Rao: Rebase looks clean but the migration diff is the risky part. We could push the non-migration commits now and open a tiny PR for the migration itself. That way we don't need the window.

CI-bot: CI summary for PR #16642:
- unit: PASS
- lint: PASS
- integration-e2e: FAIL (3/5 flaky)

Failing test snippet:
```
FAIL tests/integration/test_user_sync.py::TestUserSync::test_conflict_resolution
E   AssertionError: expected 3 users, got 2
E   at tests/integration/test_user_sync.py:142
```
Rerun command: /ci rerun integration-e2e

Maya Lopez: I can run a manual canary on dedicated tonight if we decide to land non-migration parts. Would need someone to approve the hot-path rollback if anything odd appears.

Taylor (release): My preference is to avoid schema migrations during the blackout. Options ranked: 1) land non-migration commits now, 2) run manual canary for non-migration change tonight, 3) defer full PR until after the lock. If you want a canary, Alex or Jamie needs to coordinate the manual verification checklist and be on-call for 1 hour post-landing.

Alex Chen: I can take the canary and be on-call for the hour. Ill split out the migration into a separate branch now and open PR #16643 for it. Asking CI infra: @Jamie can you kick a rerun on integration-e2e and ping infra if it flakes again?

Jamie Patel: Will do — kicking rerun now. /ci rerun integration-e2e
Ping infra: @eng-infra — seeing repeated flakes on test_user_sync in the integration suite for this PR, can you take a look if the cluster logs show any timeouts?

Sanjay Rao: If the rerun still fails, plan B is to revert the migration locally and push the rest. I'll prep the split branch so Alex can land tonight without schema changes.

CI-bot: Rerun started (job #7852). Current status: 2/5 failing, same test failing.

Maya Lopez: Copy — if it stays flaky, Alex we should only land the non-migration patch and Ill run canary tomorrow morning in US-West unless you insist on tonight.

Alex Chen: Ill wait for one more rerun result. If CI is unstable, well push the non-migration commits and postpone migration. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Taylor (release): Sounds good. Please post back in this thread after the next CI result and paste the canary checklist if you run one.
